about: Membership lists the Sky Atlas uses to order people (maintainer-answers-3, E3): the Prophet ﷺ first, then the four, then the rest of the ten, then by recorded links. Members are named by their display name in the graph, never by ID; the build stops if a name matches no person or more than one. Status: proposed. These lists have not been reviewed by the scholars' board yet, and the page says so.

lists.source: The order of succession to the caliphate (al-khulafāʾ al-rāshidūn), as the graph's own succession events record it (Abu Bakr's pledge of allegiance as caliph; Umar's, Uthman's and Ali's succession as caliph).

al-ʿashara al-mubashsharūn: the report of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAwf in Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī, Kitāb al-Manāqib (no. 3747), and of Saʿīd b. Zayd in Sunan Abī Dāwūd, Kitāb al-Sunna (no. 4649). Numbers to be checked against print by a reviewer.
